fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on safety concerns and construction problems at Dade County’s new courthouse; criticism of landlords and apartment operators withholding posted rates ahead of the tourist season; calls for a harbor patrol to address theft and oily bilge dumping and to improve safety along the bay and river; discussion of inadequate streetcar transportation on Flagler Street; and police-court and civic items including liquor-law enforcement and bond forfeiture. Sports coverage and promotion focus on efforts to bring a Jack Dempsey bout to Miami and related arena development, alongside entertainment listings and advertisements.
